title: tiedrank
summary: Rank observations using average ranks for ties.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host.

description: `tiedrank(X)` assigns ascending average ranks to numeric observations and preserves the input shape. `[R,tieadj] = tiedrank(X)` also returns tie adjustment terms.
behaviors: Equal values receive the average of their occupied ranks.
Vector inputs are ranked across all elements.
Matrix inputs are ranked independently within each column.
N-dimensional inputs are ranked along the second dimension.
`tieadj` is a scalar for vector inputs and has the ranked dimension collapsed to length one for array inputs.

faqs.question: How are ties handled?
faqs.answer: All observations in a tie group receive the average rank for that group. The second output reports the sum of `t^3 - t` terms for tie groups in each ranked slice.
